evidence.quote: The curriculum encompasses the achievement of 210 credits in seven semesters.
The programme is designed for international and German applicants alike and is taught entirely in English, with selected courses available in German as an option.

Ausländische und staatenlose Studieninteressierte mit einer im Ausland erworbenen Hochschulzugangsberechtigung (außer EU-Staatsangehörige) können sich direkt über das Bewerberportal für den gewünschten Studiengang bewerben.

Foreign and stateless prospective students with a higher education entrance qualification obtained abroad (except EU citizens) can apply directly to the desired degree program via the applicant portal.

notes: Tuition fee: the page states EUR 1,500 per semester for non-EU/EEA citizens, which corresponds to EUR 3,000 per year. The value 300000 in minor units represents EUR 3,000 for one year (two semesters). The Baden-Württemberg fee may not apply if the applicant is exempt (e.g. if the higher education entrance qualification was obtained in Germany), as noted on the programme page. The application deadline for winter semester 2026/27 is 31 May 2026; the deadline is recurring annually.

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission est requis pour les candidats non-UE.
note.en: A mandatory admission interview is required for non-EU applicants.

evidence.quote: After document validation, you will be invited to a mandatory admission interview (online or in person).

note.fr: Les candidats non-UE doivent faire reconnaître leur diplôme de fin d'études secondaires par le Bureau des programmes internationaux ou le Studienkolleg Konstanz avant le 31 mai.
note.en: Non-EU applicants must have their school leaving certificate recognized by the International Programs Office or Studienkolleg Konstanz by 31 May.

evidence.quote: Applicants with a non-EU university entrance qualification must submit their documents for recognition to the International Programs Office or the Studienkolleg Konstanz by 31 May.
